newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti shares rise on PC interest.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti shares rise on PC interest.

text.p: Shares in Italian information technology group Olivetti rose sharply on the Milan bourse on a newspaper report that the company had an offer for its ailing personal computer company, dealers said.
Milan finanical daily Il Sole 24 Ore said talks with corporate debt specialist Klesch & Co and U.S financier Bennet Lebow had been frozen in favour of a better offer for its loss-making PC comany.
At 1228 GMT, Olivetti shares were up 6.35 percent at 541 lire, after a day's high of 543 lire, in a trading volume of over 28 million shares.

The Il Sole report quoted Olivetti vice chairman Giorgio Garuzzo saying that the company had a "better offer" for the PC company. But an Olivetti spokesman declined to comment on any possible offer or even Garuzzo's comments.
Olivetti has said that it hopes to sell the PC company by the end of the year.
